task: Bring CodeMie's in-house A2A server and client to exact A2A v1.0.1 JSON-RPC wire shapes with legacy read-time normalisation, version gate, typed errors and rewritten contract tests.

key_reasoning.reason: Protocol types module, router, task manager, client trio (client, remote_agent_connection, card_resolver), utils converters, A2AAssistantHandler and assistant model card storage all change; new envelope unions and a new client error abstraction. All within one repo and one subsystem family, so XL rather than XXL.

No exact precedent (matching an external proto contract). Closest pattern is slice 3/4 card url normalisation, which only covers top-level url. Persistence trap: PydanticListType silently drops items failing validation, table=True models skip validators, and model_dump() without alias/exclude means Field(exclude=True) would strip stored card internals. Version gate and securitySchemes are security-adjacent, and the AC enumerates edge and error cases (-32009/-32601/-32602, legacy JSONB variants) with no existing parameterized template, so risk is bumped.
About 10 source files and about 10 test files modified (about 3,450 lines of existing tests to rewrite) plus a new fixtures directory and two docs: 16+ files touching project test structure.

API (router), Service (task manager, handler), DB persistence (JSONB read normalisation, no schema change or migration), External (remote A2A agents via httpx/SSE). Four layers but no schema migration, so L.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped to XL: security-adjacent work (A2A-Version gate, securitySchemes advertisement, removal of leaked dev credential) plus enumerated edge/error cases with no existing defensive test template
Component Scope XL: touches shared protocol types consumed by server, client, handler and assistant model
